reviews.title: Frozen
reviews.text: App is frozen. When I open the app I can’t do anything. Tabs won’t open. I have uninstalled and reinstalled. Also turned off phone and reopened   App still doesn’t work. Use it to keep family organized and this is recent problem.

reviews.title: Android Phones
reviews.text: I can no longer share appointments with family members with Androids. September 16, 2026 was my last date able to send appointments or information. Please advise. I rated 2 stars because I can still create appointments 🙌🏾. I need the capability to share appointments created.

reviews.title: Forced into paid trial
reviews.text: So wanted to try this app but anything that forces you into a so-called “free trial” that you have to then cancel a subscription on regardless of if you end up using it or not is just a scam in waiting 👎

reviews.title: Whats the point
reviews.text: You can add yourself, and then when it comes to adding more people( which is the point of the app!) and you can only do that if you pay 4 pound a week?! May aswell js use the stock iPhone calander if that’s the case!

reviews.title: Updates are down grades
reviews.text: Despite using the paid for version, adds for Google have now started to creep in, and apparently if I want to use the view I have always used (now unavailable) I can upgrade to premium to get it back…

reviews.title: Price has quadrupled
reviews.text: I used FamCal for ages. Stopped it briefly while on maternity leave and now it’s £3.99 per week. I used to pay £3.99 a month. We won’t be re subscribing at that extortionate cost. Deleted the app and moved to another one.

reviews.title: Works only if you upgrade
reviews.text: After 2 weeks it suddenly stopped working and wanted me to upgrade to premium. When I contacted support they informed me after 10 free entries, you are forced to upgrade to continue use. I didn’t see this anywhere before I started using. Very annoying as feel I have wasted my time planning ahead for an app that I will no longer use. If the app developers were more transparent I’d have been more likely to upgrade. £3.99 a week I daylight robbery!

app.name: Shared Family Calendar: FamCal
app.seller: Hangzhou Beesoft Information Technology Co., Ltd.
